comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Equipment with this effect:

Western Rifle EX
Cowboy Boots EX
Shirt and Denim Pants EX

When worn, a single Age Effect item confers any and all period Chrono titles for a single given age. On the plus side, that means no more having to worry about running specific Chrono quests for certain titles to make items/recipes/ganadors/etc. appear for you.

On the down side, they can only be made via Transmutation Alchemy which requires the use of costly Special Purchase Bond items and could end up taking a valuable equip slot you might need for something else (like a production booster for a time-restricted recipe). Decide for yourself if they're worth your time (pun unintended for once). Hope this helps; cheers and great online voyaging to you.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/ItemBoost
